//allowed_hosts: Host headers the MCP transport will accept. Leave empty to derive this machine's names and IPs automatically. The SDK's own default is an EMPTY allowlist, which rejects everything but localhost with 421 Misdirected Request.
//mailbox_max_bytes: Retention: oldest READ messages are evicted past this many bytes of text, or past inbox_max messages. A single message may be at most max_message_bytes.
//mailbox_store: Where messages are persisted. Relative paths sit next to config.json. Set to "" to keep the mailbox in memory only, which loses unread mail on every restart.
//output_dir: The only directory this bridge writes to (avatar_png). Relative paths sit next to config.json.
